items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist für den Einspruch beträgt zwei Wochen ab Zustellung; einzulegen ist er schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Kreisverwaltung Musterweiler – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde (formal delivery via yellow envelope) shows the delivery date handwritten as '17.04.20' (17 April 2025, a Thursday, consistent with the letter's own date of 14.04.2025). For formally delivered documents the date on the envelope is the delivery day and no days are added. The objection period for a Bußgeldbescheid is two weeks from formal delivery (§ 67 OWiG, § 43 StPO), counted under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB: the delivery day itself (Thu 17.04.2025) is not counted, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends on the day two weeks later that bears the same weekday as the delivery day: Thursday 01.05.2025. That date is Tag der Arbeit, a nationwide public holiday, so under § 43 Abs. 2 StPO / § 193 BGB the period end moves to the next working day: Friday 02.05.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and delivery costs
items.quote: Eintragung im Fahreignungsregister: 1 Punkt. Fälligkeit des Gesamtbetrags: zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft.
items.computation: Payment falls due two weeks after the notice becomes legally final (Rechtskraft), which occurs when the Einspruch period expires without an objection being filed, i.e. at the end of the (holiday-adjusted) objection deadline of Friday 02.05.2025. Counting from that event under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (the triggering day itself not counted) and § 188 Abs. 2 BGB (same weekday two weeks later), the two-week payment period ends on Friday 16.05.2025, which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz, so no further shift applies. This assumes no Einspruch is lodged; if one is filed, Rechtskraft and thus this due date do not arise.

warnings: The handwritten delivery date on the Zustellungsurkunde is truncated ('17.04.20'); the year 2025 was inferred from the surrounding context (letter dated 14.04.2025) and should be verified against the original document.

The payment due date depends on the assumption that no Einspruch is filed and that Rechtskraft occurs exactly upon expiry of the objection period; if an objection is lodged, this payment deadline does not apply.
